title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Peptic Ulcers
description: Echinacea purpurea creams have been traditionally used to treat peptic ulcers, a condition characterized by inflammation and ulcers in the stomach lining. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Echinacea purpurea creams help to reduce inflammation and prevent bacterial overgrowth, thereby alleviating symptoms of peptic ulcers.
